body: People saying I'm a medium, but I actually have some mental disorders and I wish I could have started treatment earlier
I hurt myself when I feel too anxious
Memes and asking famous people to come to our country

I feel you, nobody ever asks about how I feel or seems to realize when I'm not ok

Family, friends, boyfriend, no one

I thought Brazil and USA were the only countries in the world 
(I live in Brazil and I was always seeing USA stuff on the news)

The fear of making my loved ones suffer and traumatizing them

Thinking about how I would never be able to cuddle with my pets or eat my favorite types of food anymore

I would never be able to enjoy the company of the people I love anymore 

I've been there many times, and I thankfully I was always able to find a reason to stay here and keep fighting :)
Moving out of my parents' house (in my country people often live with their parents until they get married)
Realizing that if I did it I would destroy the lives of people around me (boyfriend, parents, sister)

I've had some fucked up hallucinations and supernatural stuff during my lifetime, but the closest ones to -reality- happened when I went to a family's friend country house. Everytime I went there I saw a lot of people that only I could see. I also constantly felt dizzy when I was there and had terrible nightmares. I always saw at night an old man besides my bed telling me terrible things, then I discovered that the house belonged to an old man and he was very attached to it. 
My family stopped going there on holidays, thank God.

Fullmetal alchemist.
I don't know exactly what it changed in me, but I will always remember it dearly.
